title: Structural properties of the implicit function defined by an integral self-consistency equation
summary: We study the integral equation $\int_0^m ηρ(η)/(C-η)\,dη= 1$ with $C>m$, where $ρ$ is a $C^1$ probability density on $[0,M]$ vanishing polynomially at $η=M$. Setting $\mathcal{I}^+(m) := \lim_{C \downarrow m}\int_0^m ηρ(η)/(C-η)\,dη$ and $Ω:= \{m \in (0,M) : \mathcal{I}^+(m) > 1\}$, the equation determines $C$ implicitly as a function of $m$ on $Ω$, and our object of study is the dimensionless ratio $β(m) := C(m)/m$.
